verdict.rationale: The RDK repo documents running viam-server against a dummy configuration (`etc/configs/fake.json`), which lets you exercise the machine API against fake components instead of real hardware. The motion docs also describe computing and inspecting an arm trajectory with PlanMotion before the arm moves, a limited dry-run capability. Nothing documents an isolated sandbox environment or separation from production data and fleets; canary testing and rollbacks address deployment safety rather than sandboxing. Missing for 10: a documented sandbox/test environment or simulation workflow, explicit isolation from production data and machines, agent-oriented guidance for testing safely, and independent corroboration.
